item.title: COLUMN: Content or aspiring
item.description: The terms content and aspiring can appear contradictory in many respects. Contentment is the state of satisfaction and comprised of the following attributes: Gratitude Acceptance Peace Satisfaction Lack of envy Aspiring is an active effort to improve, seek better, or advance.
